answer: Growth-capped admission lottery: each epoch pulse admits at most 1% of active attested IDs (proposed), drawn by public beacon from a waitlist; each ticket needs a 20-token deposit, refunded if not drawn. In a 2,000-ID net that's 20 seats/epoch (math, not measured), so a farm of 5,000 keys climbs a flat mesa for days while bleeding deposits on idle tickets. No ivory-tower committee picks; anyone can re-run the draw.
